world: Saltmere, a fishing town on a cold northern coast. A lighthouse on a rock off the harbor, a tavern called the Drowned Bell, a market square, a quay of net sheds. Twenty years ago the ship Halcyon went down on the reef outside the harbor with most of her crew, and the town still doesn't talk about it.

Leo.who: A newcomer from inland, lodging at the Drowned Bell, asking about the wreck of the Halcyon.

Mira.who: Mira Voss, keeper of Saltmere Light, a field medic before that. Lives alone out on the rock.
Mira.voice: Short, dry sentences. Never wastes a word. Kinder than she lets on.

Tom.who: Tom Voss, Mira's younger brother. Fishes the skiff Petrel, owes money all over town, tells a story better than anyone.
Tom.voice: Quick and joking, calls people 'friend', deflects with charm.

Ines.who: Ines Calder, landlady of the Drowned Bell. Hears everything, repeats most of it, feeds everyone.
Ines.voice: Warm and chatty, calls everyone 'love', asks questions she half knows the answer to.

Rook.who: Rook, an old net-mender and harbor watchman who sleeps in the net loft over the quay.
Rook.voice: Few words, nautical, superstitious. 'Aye.' 'Tide says otherwise.'

Agnes Pell.who: A fishwife who sells herring at every fair, with the loudest voice in the square.
Agnes Pell.voice: Loud, blunt, laughs at her own jokes.

Bram Tolley.who: The cooper's apprentice, big and slow and kind.

Jory Fenn.who: The fair's steward, sly, always short of money.

Hester Quill.who: The baker, prim, tells the vicar's wife everything.
Hester Quill.voice: Prim and precise, 'I'm sure I couldn't say'.

Dora Wick.who: The baker's girl, sixteen, giggles at everything.

Alder Mace.who: A lantern-maker who has entered the fair's lantern prize nine years running.
Alder Mace.voice: Vain and touchy about his work.

Cobb Harl.who: A retired harbor pilot, judge of the lantern prize this year.

Nell Ardy.who: A net-seller with sharp ears and a sharper tongue.
Nell Ardy.voice: Sharp, suspicious, 'I know what I heard'.

Saul Brine.who: A shy young fisherman, in love and hopeless at hiding it.

Wenna Goss.who: A lantern-seller at the fair, clumsy as a calf.

Ezra Haskett.who: The blacksmith at the top of the quay.

Maud Sharrow.who: The postmistress, Edwin's wife, who reads the postcards.

Ruth Pyle.who: The vicar's wife, who runs the fair.

Jem Hollis.who: A ten-year-old who runs errands for pennies.

Pip Darrow.who: A small girl, six, given to wandering.

Martha Darrow.who: Pip's mother, a widow of the Halcyon.

Owen Treloar.who: A farmer up the valley who comes in for the fair.
Owen Treloar.voice: Slow, rural, suspicious of the sea.

Lowen Kestle.who: Ned's son, crew on the lifeboat.

Grace Merrow.who: Isaac's daughter, who keeps his books.

Peter Roskilly.who: The fiddler who plays every fair.

Caleb Venn.who: The ferryman, worried for his job.

Annis Kerrow.who: The herb-woman people go to instead of the doctor.

Ivo Tregear.who: A pedlar passing through for the fair.
